reviews.comment: I took her COMM 203 class over the summer. EASIEST class, but very beneficial. Light reading and short videos to inform you about the speeches. 3 major speeches and 2-3 mini speeches. You will do some writing, but nothing extensive. She gives very helpful feedback and grades fairly. Very nice and responds to emails promptly.

Ms. Letteney was a great TA. Although she wasn't directly our professor, she gave us weekly lectures and graded all of our work. She is very sweet, kind, and genuinely wants to help you succeed. She also grades graciously. I would recommend her for any class.
